title.narrative: BIOSEC - Enhanced Biosecurity in South-East Asia P81

description.narrative: The purpose is a set of recommendations for an improved biosecurity management system in South-East Asia, addressing biosecurity awareness, legislation and guidelines, enforcement, high-risk biological materials and facilities, microbial forensics, physical and information security framework for facilities (taking into account emerging technologies), information exchange as well as effective tools to enhance capabilities to respond to highly-communicable diseases
